🚨 Holy Redeemer Health System files for chapter 11 in Pennsylvania

HOLY REDEEMER HEALTH SYSTEM
📊 Assets: $100M-$500M | Liabilities: $100M-$500M | Creditors: 200-999 | Industry: General Medical and Surgical Hospitals | District: Eastern District of Pennsylvania

Chapter 11 – Filing Summary
_____________________________________________
Eastern District of Pennsylvania • November 1, 2026

Holy Redeemer Health System, a Meadowbrook, PA-based healthcare business, filed for chapter 11 protection on November 1, 2026 in the Eastern District of Pennsylvania.

As stated in the bankruptcy filing, the company operates as a healthcare business under several dba names including Redeemer Health and HRH Transitional Care Unit. Current operations include the management of the 167-bed Holy Redeemer Hospital and various care facilities. The system entered restructuring following the appointment of interim leadership in September 2026 and defaults on approximately $87 million to $90 million in bond payments due in late 2026.

Historically known as Holy Redeemer Health System, the organization rebranded to Redeemer Health in 2020. The system has faced significant financial headwinds, reporting consecutive years of operating losses leading up to its 2026 filing.

Key Details
_____________________________________________
– Annual operating loss of $17M in fiscal 2025 [Source: Philadelphia Inquirer (2025)]
– Total revenue of $480M in fiscal 2025 [Source: Philadelphia Inquirer (2025)]
– Staffed hospital bed count of 167 in October 2026 [Source: Philadelphia Inquirer (2026)]
– Total employee headcount of 2,194 in March 2026 [Source: Revelio Labs (2026)]
– Unrestricted reserves of $127M in October 2026 [Source: Philadelphia Inquirer (2026)]

⚖️ Professionals
_____________________________________________
Debtor's Counsel: Dilworth Paxson LLP

#Bankruptcy #Chapter11 #GeneralMedicalAndSurgicalHospitals
